Notes:
V:  "Vintage" account, for which net plant balance is amortized using the respective depreciation rate.  Above, Original Cost (col. D) is reduced by the depreciation reserve (col. E) to determine Depreciable Balance (col. F).
T:  "Transportation" account, which is depreciated by asset.
S:  "Software" account, which are amortized using the same depreciation rate as Account 391.2, per FERC guidance.  "Software" accounts are also "Vintage" accounts.
All other accounts are "Group" accounts, which are depreciated by applying depreciation rates to gross plant balances.
R:  Gross Plant includes certain retired assets that have not yet been removed from the Company's books.  Above, Original Cost (col. D) is reduced by the original costs of retired assets (col. E) to determine Depreciable Balance (col. F).

Notes:
V:  "Vintage" account, for which net plant balance is amortized using the respective depreciation rate.  Above, Original Cost (col. D) is reduced by the depreciation reserve (col. E) to determine Depreciable Balance (col. F).
T:  "Transportation" account, which is depreciated by asset.
S:  "Software" account, which are amortized using the same depreciation rate as Account 391.2, per FERC guidance.  "Software" accounts are also "Vintage" accounts.
All other accounts are "Group" accounts, which are depreciated by applying depreciation rates to gross plant balances.
R:  Gross Plant includes certain retired assets that have not yet been removed from the Company's books.  Above, Original Cost (col. D) is reduced by the original costs of retired assets (col. E) to determine Depreciable Balance (col. F).

Notes:
V:  "Vintage" account, for which net plant balance is amortized using the respective depreciation rate.  Above, Original Cost (col. D) is reduced by the depreciation reserve (col. E) to determine Depreciable Balance (col. F).
T:  "Transportation" account, which is depreciated by asset.
S:  "Software" account, which are amortized using the same depreciation rate as Account 391.2, per FERC guidance.  "Software" accounts are also "Vintage" accounts.
All other accounts are "Group" accounts, which are depreciated by applying depreciation rates to gross plant balances.
R:  Gross Plant includes certain retired assets that have not yet been removed from the Company's books.  Above, Original Cost (col. D) is reduced by the original costs of retired assets (col. E) to determine Depreciable Balance (col. F).

V:  "Vintage" account, for which net plant balance is amortized using the respective depreciation rate.  Above, Original Cost (col. D) is reduced by the depreciation reserve (col. E) to determine Depreciable Balance (col. F).
T:  "Transportation" account, which is depreciated by asset.
S:  "Software" account, which are amortized using the same depreciation rate as Account 391.2, per FERC guidance.  "Software" accounts are also "Vintage" accounts.
All other accounts are "Group" accounts, which are depreciated by applying depreciation rates to gross plant balances.
R:  Gross Plant includes certain retired assets that have not yet been removed from the Company's books.  Above, Original Cost (col. D) is reduced by the original costs of retired assets (col. E) to determine Depreciable Balance (col. F).
